title: Project Progress Rainbow Settings
description: Display, progress and animation options. Anything set here overrides the quick toggles in the plugin header.

calcMode.title: Progress calculation
calcMode.description: Count completed tasks, or weigh by time estimates.

showBacklog.title: Include backlog tasks
showBacklog.description: Count tasks sitting in project backlogs.

hideDone.title: Hide completed (100%) projects
hideDone.description: Hide cards that reached 100% from the grid.

animateBars.title: Animated flow effect
animateBars.description: Moving stripes + light sweep on every progress bar.

flowSpeed.title: Flow speed
flowSpeed.description: How fast the bar animation flows.

maxMilestones.title: Milestones shown per card
maxMilestones.description: How many milestone rows each project card previews.
